name: attic
description: Offloads context. Stashes findings, decisions and long outputs into a project-local .attic/ folder and keeps only a one-line index in the conversation, so context stays lean and survives /compact.

interface.shortDescription: Offload context into .attic/ so it survives compaction and new sessions
interface.longDescription: Stashes findings, decisions and long outputs into a project-local .attic/ folder and keeps only a one-line index in the conversation. The live context stays lean and what matters survives /compact, /clear and new sessions.
